fields.title: Traveloka surface probe result
fields.description: One record per proxy round: WAF-token minting status, session bootstrap status, and per-endpoint reachability checks. A round where session bootstrap itself failed short-circuits to just round/exitIp/error.

exitIp.title: Exit IP
exitIp.description: Public IP address used for this round's requests.

error.title: Bootstrap error
error.description: Present only when session bootstrap failed before any endpoint checks ran.

bootStatus.title: Boot status
bootStatus.description: HTTP status of the /api/v2/user/context/web bootstrap call.

wafTokenMinted.title: WAF token minted
wafTokenMinted.description: Whether an aws-waf-token was successfully minted for this round.

wafTokenLength.title: WAF token length
wafTokenLength.description: Character length of the minted token, 0 if none was minted.

mintError.title: Mint error
mintError.description: Error message from the token-minting subprocess, if it failed.

datadomeHotelPage.title: Hotel page probe
datadomeHotelPage.description: Result of fetching /en-id/hotel: status code, byte count, and whether a captcha-delivery page was served; or an error string.

checks.title: Endpoint checks
checks.description: Per-endpoint probe results keyed by check name (hotel-searchList, hotel-staticSearch, xperience-searchV2, xperience-detail, hotel-autocomplete, pps-multileg, ugc-getReviews, flight-price-table). Each value carries status, wafAction, bytes and a response snippet, or an error.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for scanning probe rounds.
